name: 五档环形弹力阻力带款
description: 五色五档阻力阶梯一目了然，天然乳胶亲肤耐用，一袋装下全身训练

styleLock.direction: clean studio-driven fitness suite: white flat-lay skeleton, natural-light training scenes, blue-gray comparison boards; the five-color resistance ladder is the visual spine
styleLock.temperature: neutral-cool studio plus natural daylight warmth in scenes
styleLock.backgroundSystem: product shots always seamless pure white #FFFFFF; comparison boards royal blue #2E86C1 panels versus light gray #D5D8DC panels; scenes bright home or outdoor daylight with calm neutral surfaces
styleLock.lightingSystem: even shadowless top softbox for flat lays; natural diffused daylight for scenes; side-backlight for latex texture macros
styleLock.surfaceSystem: floating flat-lay with no visible table edge; matte latex bands with a gentle natural curl at the ends; wood floor and yoga mat in scenes
styleLock.typography: bold geometric sans-serif headlines with light sans body, one headline plus one support line per image
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-color line icons; filled-dot count (1-5) as the level language; left-win right-lose comparison rows
styleLock.presentationRules: five bands always appear together in fixed order green-blue-yellow-red-black with dot counts 1-5; the band is the only saturated focal point in scenes against low-saturation outfits; whitespace 25-40%
noDrift: no neon gradients or heavy filters
no brand marks, URLs or level words
no pull-up or tube-band forms in frame
no changed color order or dot rules
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: a clean, studio-driven fitness suite for a five-piece latex loop resistance band set. Hero, detail and variant shots are flat lays on seamless pure white #FFFFFF under even shadowless top softbox light; the five bands - green #8DC63F, blue #2E6DA8, yellow #F2C230, red #D5302F, black #1C1C1C - always appear together as a resistance ladder in a fixed color order, and the filled-dot count from one to five is the recurring level language. Comparison and pain boards use a strict two-column system: royal blue #2E86C1 winning panels with white copy, light gray #D5D8DC losing panels with dark copy, thin line icons, no photographic clutter and no competitor branding. Lifestyle scenes use natural diffused daylight in bright home settings with a single saturated band as the only color focal point against low-saturation outfits. Bold geometric sans headlines, one short headline plus one support line per image, matte latex texture with a gentle natural curl. No brand marks, no neon gradients, no moody dark tones, no extra hues, no pull-up or tube-band forms.
